entries.01bdf0d254fd176c: The business designs, manufactures and sells backplanes, racks, board computers and other products for industrial computers built into social and industrial infrastructure. The company has a single segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,993 million. Sales centre on custom products tailored to customer specifications, and the company also sells completed products in which power supply units, fans and other components are installed in racks to form computer units.
